source_files.normalization: The repository copy preserves the source content and has one final LF added by the patch transport.

in_scope: The existing Skill, canonical planning, quality, evidence, runtime, media, provider boundary, tests, fixtures, documentation and portable distribution
Minimal production-proof and evidence-correctness improvements justified by the current prompt
Read-only local runtime discovery and safe local generation only when the observed resource contract permits it
out_of_scope_without_new_authority: Paid API calls, cloud or public uploads, publication, voice cloning or new likeness transfer
Downloading multi-gigabyte model weights or changing the host environment to satisfy the second-adapter row
Destructive queue/process mutation, cancellation of unrelated jobs or fabrication of audiovisual evidence

architecture: Bounded ownership across core, quality, evidence, runtime, media, provider and CLI
Progressive disclosure, feature-scoped adapters, truthful degradation and maintainable interfaces
verification: Deterministic regression, known-bad, metamorphic and integration coverage
Runtime discovery/resource evidence, immutable attempts/artifacts/hashes and oracle-bound observations
Transition, repair, assembly, portability and fresh independent review evidence
production: Real generated multi-shot media with accepted semantic/continuity evidence
Real bounded repair/re-anchor, assembly lineage, audio/video acceptance and human editorial review where applicable
LF-001, LF-002 and LF-003 production acceptance before a proven verdict

proven_requires: Architecture, verification and production pillars pass independently
LF-001, LF-002 and LF-003 are accepted from real generated artifacts
Multi-shot continuity, semantic QA, real repair, assembly and required editorial checks pass
Fresh independent critic returns PASS against the frozen candidate
Fresh distribution passes integrity and portability checks
No unresolved critical production blocker remains
candidate_requires: Architecture and verification primary gates pass
Substantial accepted LF-001, LF-002 and LF-003 evidence plus real multi-shot production, repair and assembly
Only a documented non-core frontier such as optional LF-004, a specialized FLF mode or the second adapter remains blocked

criteria.name: Fresh baseline and preservation
criteria.acceptance: Record exact tests, package, runtime, queue, devices, VRAM, profiles, workflows, artifacts, failed attempts, docs and critic state before edits; preserve valid implementation and historical failures.

criteria.name: Truth-layer separation
criteria.acceptance: Keep user intent, canonical plan, execution, generated bytes and evidence as distinct linked layers; documentation, tests, schema validity, node presence and metadata never become semantic production proof.

criteria.name: Resource safety
criteria.acceptance: Selected device, observed free VRAM, explicit floor and explicit margin are required; FREE_VRAM below REQUIRED_FLOOR times MARGIN blocks before POST even when a caller requests degraded execution.

criteria.name: Security and workload safety
criteria.acceptance: No secret, weight, private-media or unsafe absolute path enters distribution; no paid/external/destructive queue side effect occurs without authority; unrelated runtime jobs remain untouched.

criteria.name: Immutable evidence
criteria.acceptance: Every submission creates a new immutable attempt and every artifact binds attempt, shot, file, hash, media metadata and status; OOM, failed, partial, drift and repair evidence remain available.

criteria.name: Oracle discipline and QA states
criteria.acceptance: Mechanical, semantic, transition, audio, multi-frame and human claims use appropriately strong oracles and retain evidence, confidence and limitations; unknown/unobserved/not-run states are never coerced into PASS.

criteria.name: Canonical contradiction gate
criteria.acceptance: Compilation rejects canonical state contradictions such as incompatible door, motion, seating, speaker turn, lighting or camera declarations; repairs canonical state rather than patching generated prose.

criteria.name: Known-bad and metamorphic coverage
criteria.acceptance: Executable cases cover missing/wrong hashes, duplicate transition bytes, state/door contradictions, ownership without contact, speaker/listener failures, stale profiles, FLF overclaim, A/V mismatch and repair without revalidation; invariant-preserving mutations remain tested.

criteria.name: LF-001 vehicle-entry production
criteria.acceptance: The 10–15 second human-to-vehicle chain uses the causal phases APPROACH, PRE_CONTACT, HANDLE_CONTACT, DOOR_OPEN, BODY_ORIENTATION, ENTRY, SEATED_STATE and DOOR_CLOSE, with predeclared shot contracts, state, references, camera, acceptance and honest production status.

criteria.name: LF-001 transitions and assembly
criteria.acceptance: S01→S02 and S02→S03 require distinct real artifacts, hashes, observations, compatible state, identity/environment/action-phase continuity, repair lineage and final assembly; missing/duplicate/teleported/black/frozen/A/V-invalid media blocks acceptance.

criteria.name: Real repair and re-anchor
criteria.acceptance: A naturally occurring production failure follows DETECT→LOCALIZE→OWNER→MINIMAL CHANGE→NEW ATTEMPT→OBSERVE→TRANSITION REVALIDATION→REASSEMBLY within an explicit budget, preserving failed attempts and unaffected siblings.

criteria.name: FLF capability
criteria.acceptance: FIRST_ONLY, LAST_ONLY and FIRST_AND_LAST are tested independently when available; endpoint identity/object/environment/motion and delivery use real artifact observations, otherwise status remains PARTIAL/UNSUPPORTED/UNKNOWN.

criteria.name: LF-002 dialogue, performance and audio
criteria.acceptance: The 20–30 second two-person case separates semantics, voice, performance, lip-sync and mix; enforces speaker/listener, stimulus→processing→reaction→response, timing, gaze, object interaction and applicable audio layers.

criteria.name: LF-003 bounded long form
criteria.acceptance: The 45–60 second case has Scene Bible, predeclared timeline, dependent shot graph, continuity ledger, recurring identities, object interaction, audio, transitions, repair, assembly and human editorial review.

criteria.name: Second real adapter
criteria.acceptance: Use the same canonical scene for Adapter A/B differential; preserve intent, entities, causal order, state, locks and acceptance while syntax/runtime may differ; do not download large weights without authority.

criteria.name: Architecture and context minimization
criteria.acceptance: Ownership remains conceptual rather than line-count based; deterministic code handles schemas, state arithmetic, hashes, provenance, capability intersection, media QA and assembly while creative judgment remains in the Skill/director; references load only when risk activates them.

criteria.name: Fresh independent critic
criteria.acceptance: After all material changes, freeze the candidate and obtain a fresh non-inherited read-only review with candidate fingerprint, dates, criterion matrix, findings/severity/evidence, mutation sentinel and PASS/REJECT/INCOMPLETE verdict; any material mutation makes it stale.

criteria.name: Distribution and final accounting
criteria.acceptance: Build only after freeze; record ZIP CRC/SHA, manifest, links, compile, secret/weight/absolute-path scans, external-CWD smoke test, capability matrix, maturity levels, independent scores, claims and remaining gaps.
